instruction: Find the maximum stock price in the table and save it to a text file named "result.txt" on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum stock price from column C (Stock Price) in the Excel file. Verified with Python: maximum price is 383.27 (from row 47, WPO - The Washington Post Company). The custom getter reads the text file content from VM, and the custom metric extracts and compares the numeric value with tolerance 0.01. Note: This uses outcome-based verification which is standard for OSWorld tasks - it verifies the final result (correct value in file) but does not verify the process (whether LibreOffice Calc was used).
metadata.verification_details: Processed all 61 rows (48 valid prices). Maximum price: 383.27. Verification approach: outcome-based (checks final result file only).
